captions.detailed: A woodworking face vise featuring a wide, flat, light-brown hardwood jaw face mounted to a dark-brown wooden rear frame. A moving front jaw slides along two parallel black square guide bars, which act as a prismatic slider. The center features a dark-metallic threaded leadscrew operated by a light-brown turned wooden handwheel on the front.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a woodworking face vise with a wide hardwood jaw, a rear frame, a moving front jaw that slides on two parallel square guide bars, and a central threaded leadscrew with a turned wooden handwheel.
captions.factory: Construct the rear frame using box primitives. Model the sliding front jaw as a wide box, and add two parallel square rods (boxes) and a central cylinder representing the leadscrew. Create the turned handwheel using a combination of cylinder and sphere primitives, then define a prismatic joint for the sliding front jaw assembly relative to the fixed rear frame.
